The '''Coth Fuuras system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing [[Coth Fuuras space station|Coth Fuuras]] [[Space station/Legends|Space station]].
